artworks.title: Calliope
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the upper thigh upwards. She is seated, with her left hand on her side and her right hand palm open and slightly extended forward. She has a serene expression with large eyes, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair is neatly styled with a middle part and a braided detail. She is wearing a long-sleeved gown with a rounded neckline, a necklace with spherical beads, a bracelet on her left wrist, and an earring on her right ear. A few books are stacked next to her on the left side, and some beads or pearls are scattered on the ground next to the books. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Thalia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated from the knees up in profile, with her head slightly turned to the right. Her facial features are detailed, with a serene expression, a straight nose, and soft lips. She has braided hair styled in a bun with an earring on one ear. She wears a flowing gown, and holds a scepter in her left hand while her right hand rests on her lap. An open book is on the ground near her feet. The background is dark and textured, with a rocky surface. The image is framed with text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Melpomene
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman from the torso up to her knees. She is seated slightly sideways, with her upper body facing the viewer. Her head is turned to the side, and she has a calm and direct gaze. The woman's facial features are detailed, with a composed expression. She has medium-length hair that is parted in the middle and tied with a ribbon. She is wearing a long-sleeved gown, and one can see a fold in the fabric. She holds a scroll in her right hand and a dagger in her left hand. Books are stacked on the ground beside her. The background features a textured surface.

artworks.title: Clio
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a three-quarters view with her full body visible. She is sitting with her head tilted downward, focusing on the tablet or book in her right hand. Her facial features are soft with closed eyes and a peaceful expression. Her hair is styled in an intricate updo. She is wearing a long-sleeved, full-length dress with the fabric gathered above her waist. Her left hand is holding an object, and there are two books on the ground next to her. The background has a textured pattern, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Terpsichore
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman holding a stringed musical instrument. She is shown from the knees up, angled slightly to the left, leaning backward. She has well-defined facial features, closed lips, and eyes looking ahead. Her hair is styled back with loose strands, partially covered by a headscarf. She wears a long dress with voluminous sleeves and an earring on her left ear. The background has a detailed, cross-hatched texture.

artworks.title: Frederik de Vries
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy seated with his right leg extended sideways on a large, curly-haired dog standing in the foreground. The boy has a rounded face with a small, pointed nose and subtle, upward-curving lips. He has neatly cropped hair under a broad-brimmed hat and is dressed in a richly textured outfit with a ruffled collar and sleeves, a patterned belt, and a piece of jewelry around his neck. He holds a bird in his right hand with outstretched wings. Behind him is a tree with lush foliage, and the background shows a mountainous landscape with a turret-like structure in the distance. Latin text is elegantly inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Cliff on a Seashore
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, green and black
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with rugged terrain, including rock formations and a structure resembling a chapel or house. In the distance, there are ship masts, clouds, and turbulent seas with a ship navigating the waters. The scene is portrayed with bold brushstrokes in earthy tones, creating a moody atmosphere. Layered clouds fill the sky above.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Waterfall
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, olive and black
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high horizon showing trees, hills, and flying birds. On the right, an old mill with a waterwheel near a tree is depicted. The brushstrokes are detailed and illustrative, defining the textures of trees, water, and structures. The color palette consists of earthy tones like brown, beige, and green.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Farmhouse
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, olive and black
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a winding path leading to a thatched-roof house surrounded by trees and shrubs. A figure walks with two animals near the house. In the distance, a village can be seen with a few structures. The sky is filled with swirling brushstrokes suggesting clouds, and birds fly overhead. The color palette is subdued with black outlines emphasizing details.

artworks.title: Tethys
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, olive and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a large sea creature. The person has wavy hair, a crown of leaves and flowers, and is holding reins attached to the sea creature. They are draped in flowing fabric. The background features a seascape with waves and mythical sea creatures.

artworks.title: Pluto
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, green and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowned figure standing before a blazing backdrop. The central figure, depicted from the back, appears to be nude except for a draped piece of cloth over one shoulder and a crown on their head. The figure has a muscular build and is standing with one arm extended outward. The background shows flames rising upwards. To the left, there is a structure that resembles an ancient temple or building and below it, a gathering of figures. The figure stands near a large overturned vessel or pot.

artworks.title: Oceanus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in sepia-ochre, olive and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure riding a large sea creature. The central figure holds a staff and reins attached to the creature's snout. The creature has detailed scales and large eyes. This scene is enclosed in an oval vignette with a seascape in the background, including waves and another figure. Shades of brown give the image an antiquated, sepia-toned effect.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Cacus
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in two shades of sepia and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print of two nude men in a cave. One man is standing over another fallen man, raising a long club behind his head with both arms, as if ready to strike. The man on the ground is reaching upward with one hand and extending one of his legs upward. The standing man appears to be wearing a ragged lion-skin cloak, and both men have highly defined muscles. The background is chaotic and filled with other people and animals.

artworks.title: Aether
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in gold, olive and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with a dynamic pose. One hand is raised upwards and the other is pointing downwards. The individual's body is exposed with well-defined muscles. They are wearing a flowing piece of drapery attached from one shoulder. The person's face is angled upwards with finely carved facial features. They have curly hair and an object resembling antlers or tree branches on their head. No jewelry is visible. The background features swirling patterns resembling clouds, creating a dramatic setting around the figure. The oval framing adds to the sense of movement and energy in the composition.

artworks.title: Nox
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in ochre-sepia, dark olive and black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a print showing an ornately decorated chariot pulled towards the left by bat-like creatures. A nude figure with pale skin sits at the front of the chariot, holding a torch aloft, a small owl next to them. The chariot has a hood over the figure's head, carvings on the side, and four large wheels. Above the figure, a rooster is perched on the hood of the chariot. A person with pale skin and long hair appears to sleep in the back of the chariot, their head resting on their hand, round white symbols surrounding them. The chariot appears to rest on top of fluffy white clouds, and the sky in the background is olive green. The print is oval, and beyond it is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Allegory of Prudence
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding two snakes by their heads. She has a calm expression and soft facial features, with her hair tucked under a draped cloth covering her head. She wears a long gown with intricate detailing, and the background features nature elements, rocks, and a cityscape with grand architectural structures. People are seen in the distance on a balcony. The circular composition unites the natural foreground and built environment in the background.

artworks.title: Sight
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two people positioned closely together. The woman on the left is seated and facing slightly toward the viewer, while her upper body is turned slightly toward the man beside her who leans in from the right. Her facial features include full cheeks and a small, pointed chin, and her hair is styled in an elaborate updo with braids. She wears a dress with a detailed lace collar and ruffled sleeves, along with a pearl necklace and earrings. She holds a mirror in her left hand. The man wears a large hat, a mustache, and a beard; his expression seems animated, and he holds a hand out toward the woman. His clothing features a ruffled collar and pleated fabric. The background consists of engravings of foliage and a setting sun.

artworks.title: Hearing
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from about the waist up. The person in the foreground is sitting with a slight turn to their right, their eyes downcast as they play a keyboard instrument. They have a detailed expression, with their hair styled in small curls framing the face and tied back. They are wearing an ornate garment featuring a ruffled collar and intricate embroidery along the sleeves and bodice. A necklace is visible, and they are wearing earrings. The second person stands slightly behind and to the right, holding what appears to be a book or music sheet and looking towards it. They have similar styled hair but it is swept back from the face. The background includes detailed foliage and drapery.

artworks.title: Smell
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a couple seated closely together. The woman is on the left, facing the man while holding a basket of flowers. She has classic facial features with curled hair. She wears a dress and a pearl necklace. The man is on the right, leaning towards her, with wavy hair, and wearing a garment with ruffled sleeves. He is holding a flower and touching a dog in front of the woman. The background includes a vase with flowers on a ledge. The scene is intricately engraved with detailed textures and features. Latin text is included at the bottom.

artworks.title: Taste
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up, seated closely together. One person is holding an apple and the other holds a glass. The person on the left is a man with distinct facial features and wavy hair, looking at the apple. The woman on the right has hair styled in a bun with curls and appears to be looking at the man. She wears a dress with puffed sleeves and tracery, while he wears intricate patterned garments with a visible collar and buttons on the sleeve. Grapes are placed near the wine glass held by the man, surrounded by a lush background of leafy branches. In the background, there is a small, crouching figure near a tree. The scene is framed with ornate script text along the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Touch
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of two figures, a man and a woman, depicted from the waist up. They are positioned closely together, facing each other with the woman's face slightly turned towards her partner while both lean in intimately. The woman's facial features are classic, with a smooth complexion and delicate features. Her hair is styled elegantly, pulled up with curls framing her face. She is wearing a necklace of round beads and an off-shoulder garment adorned with floral patterns. The man's expression is attentive, with curly hair and strong features. His arm wraps around the woman's shoulder. The background features draped fabric, adding a romantic atmosphere to the scene, with fine lines and shading that give depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Frederick II, King of Denmark and Norway
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his left and has distinct facial features: high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent cheekbones, beard, mustache, and short, combed-back hair. He is wearing ornate armor with intricate designs, along with an elaborate ruff around his neck. The background includes text "FRIDERICVS II. D. G. DANIE. NORVEGIAE. & C. REX. OBIIT. A. 1588" encircling an oval border framing the image.

artworks.title: Jan Nicquet
artworks.description: This image shows an upper-body portrait of a man looking directly at the viewer. His head is turned slightly to his left with a serious expression. He has a full mustache and goatee, short, neatly combed back hair, and wears elaborate clothing typical of the late 16th century, including a large ruff collar, detailed doublet, and flowing cape. His right hand holds a small object. To the right is an ornate coat of arms with scrollwork and an animal motif, possibly an eagle. The background has a lined pattern, and below the portrait is an inscription in calligraphic script.

artworks.title: Johannes Zurenus (Jan van Zuren)
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man facing left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a full, wavy beard, curly hair, prominent cheekbones, and holds an open book in his right hand. He is dressed in robes with a fur-trimmed collar and appears contemplative. The background is plain and there is text below the illustration.
